statement.en: For every carrier and relation, continuation is 缘 met with a class; its positions depend on the class, a class constant under 缘 never lets a continuation end, a line's own regularity is the class's core, and the World model's arising, ceasing, lineage and passing are its instances.
statement.zh: 对每个载体与关系，续是缘与类之合；其诸位依于类，对缘有常之类其续永不终了，一条线之理是其类之核；World 模型之生起、终止、世系与传是其实例。

laws.en: Continuation is 缘 met with a class: one occurrence continues another under a class where the first is a condition of the second and the two are alike under the class. A line is the reach of continuation, and an occurrence begins, abides or ends in it where it has no predecessor, both, or no successor; beginning and abiding exclude each other, as do abiding and ending, and every line runs along the reach of 缘.
laws.zh: 续是缘与类之合：一事在一个类下续另一事，当前者为后者之缘且二者在此类下相同。一条线是续之可及；一事在其中无前者为生，前后皆有为住，无后者为亡；生与住不并，住与亡不并；每条线都沿缘之可及。

laws.en: No position stands by itself: the positions depend on the class. Under the one, continuation is 缘 itself, and an occurrence begins exactly where nothing conditions it; in a net without self-conditioning, an occurrence with a condition and a consequence abides under the one and both begins and ends under identity.
laws.zh: 无一位自立：诸位依于类。在“一”之下，续即缘本身，一事恰在无物为其缘时为生；在无自缘之网中，有缘有果之事，在“一”之下为住，在相等之下既生又亡。

laws.en: Coarsening: under a coarser class every continuation remains one, so what ends under the coarser class ends under the finer and what abides under the finer abides under the coarser; something can end under the finer class and not end under the coarser.
laws.zh: 粗化：在较粗的类下，每一续仍是续；故在粗类下亡者在细类下亦亡，在细类下住者在粗类下亦住；可有一事在细类下亡而在粗类下不亡。

laws.en: A class constant under 缘 (E˘;R ⊆ R;E˘) never lets a continuation end: whatever continues something is continued, symmetric class or not. So a class under which some line ends is not constant, and a line that ends has its own regularity in its class's core, not in the class.
laws.zh: 对缘有常之类（E˘;R ⊆ R;E˘），其续永不终了：凡续某事者，自身亦被续，类对称与否皆然。故有线终了之类不有常，一条终了之线，其理在其类之核，不在其类。

laws.en: The core of a class under 缘 lies inside it, is constant and symmetric, and contains every symmetric constant relation inside it: it is the greatest one, and the core of a class is a class. Read both ways, constant under 缘 and under its converse, the core carries beginning, abiding and ending: for a class, what the two-way core relates shares beginning, abiding and ending (altering, a relation between two occurrences with a finer class, is not a mark of one occurrence).
laws.zh: 一个类在缘下之核在其内，有常且对称，并包含其内每一个对称而有常之关系：它是最大者；类之核亦是类。双向读之（对缘及其逆皆有常），对一个类，双向之核所关联者生同、住同、亡同（异是两事之间带较细之类之关系，不是一事之相）。

laws.en: Continuation is not defined through the core: in a flame of three moments ending in ash, the moments continue one another under 'flame or not', yet under that class's core no two occurrences continue one another, since the moments' futures differ by how long is left.
laws.zh: 续不由核来定义：三刻之火终于灰，诸刻在“火与否”之类下相续，而在此类之核下无两事相续，因诸刻之未来以所余之长短而异。

laws.en: For a class, constancy is exactly closure of the coarse net: E;R;E ⊆ R;E. Read without taking classes apart, every 缘 inside a class becomes a loop at both its ends; the coarse net therefore takes 缘 between classes, and it joins only different classes.
laws.zh: 对一个类，有常恰是粗网之闭合：E;R;E ⊆ R;E。不分开类而读，类内每一缘在其两端成环；故粗网取类与类之间的缘，它只连不同之类。

laws.en: Renewal: an occurrence renews where it is a condition of a beginning that goes on; renewal at the grain of a class reads the same relation at that grain, and every renewal is one at every grain. Renewal without end is the greatest family each member of which renews into a line reaching the family again; it renews. Under the one there is neither.
laws.zh: 复生：一事为一个继续下去之生之缘，谓之复生；以一个类之粒度读同一关系，为粗复生，凡复生皆是各粒度之复生。生生是最大之族，其每一员都复生出一条再到此族之线；生生必复生。在“一”之下二者皆无。

laws.en: Boundaries in the grammar itself: that every occurrence, in every model, either begins or has a predecessor is exactly excluded middle; under fission, sameness read along lines either way is not transitive; every single 缘 is a continuation under some class, and two conditions of one occurrence, each alike to it, make a merge: it continues both; reach is an order of precedence only where nothing reaches itself.
laws.zh: 文法自身的边界：“每一事或生或有前，对一切模型”恰是排中律；有分叉时，沿线双向所读之同不传递；每一条缘在某个类下都是续，一事的两个缘，各与此事相同，成合：此事续二者；可及只在无物可及自身时才是先后之序。
declarations: Becoming.«四相之定当且仅当排中»

laws.en: Lines: a line under a class stays within it; a beginning under a finer class continued under a coarser one is an alteration; what begins under a coarser class begins under the finer; and where every step keeps a class or carries a mark, a line whose ends the class tells apart has a marked step.
laws.zh: 线：类下之线不出其类；在细类下生而在粗类下续者为异；在粗类下生者在细类下亦生；凡每一步或保一类或带一标者，其两端为此类所分之线，必有带标之一步。

laws.en: Holding, mutual need and leaning-on through constancy apply only to lines that do not end; through the core they apply to all: a class suffices for another's regularity where what is alike under both is alike under the other's core. The constancy forms imply the core forms, mutual need through constancy is symmetric and nothing needs itself, a class is constant exactly where it lies in its core, and the core is monotone in the class. In the flame of three moments and its ash, "flame or not" and "the same fuel left" need each other through the core, and every class that with "flame or not" tells its four occurrences apart suffices for its regularity, so the witness singles out neither fuel nor a direction; in two flames side by side the fuel left suffices for the regularity of "flame or not" while the joint class relates two distinct occurrences (the two flames at one moment), and sameness of flame does not suffice.
laws.zh: 以有常言之自持、相须、因于，只适用于不终了之线；以核言之，则适用于一切：两类俱同者在其一之核下亦同，则另一类足以定此类之理。以有常者蕴涵以核者；相须对称，无物自相须；一个类恰在含于其核时有常；核随类单调。三刻之火及其灰中，“火与否”与“余薪同”以核相须，凡与“火与否”合而能分开此四事之类皆足以定火之理，故此见证既不挑出薪，也不定方向；两火并燃之中，余薪同足以定“火与否”之理，而二类之合关联两个不同之事（同刻之两火）；同火则不足。
declarations: Becoming.«类有常当且仅当含于核»

laws.en: Renewing into: an occurrence conditions a beginning whose line reaches another. Ceasing, defined positively and inductively along renewing into: an occurrence ceases where everything it renews into ceases, the least property so closed. Renewal without end, the greatest family each member of which renews into a member, does not cease (生生不息). Ceasing concerns what an occurrence renews into, not its line: one that does not itself renew ceases, so one on whose line nothing renews ceases; under the one everything ceases.
laws.zh: 复生至：一事为一始之缘，而此始之线达于另一事。息，正面而沿复生至以归纳定义：一事所复生至者皆息，则此事息；息是如此封闭之最小之性。生生是每一员皆复生至族中一员之最大之族，在此族中者不息（生生不息）。息所论是一事所复生至者，不是其线：自身不复生之事息，故其线上无物复生之事息；在“一”之下皆息。

laws.en: The World model's arising and ceasing along one relatum are beginning and ending under 'alike in activity', occurrences being pairs of a step and a relatum; ceasing to be is an ending and coming to be a beginning; the finite-world law of arising and ceasing is exactly the decidability of the positions.
laws.zh: World 模型在同一关系项上的生起与终止，是“活动相同”之类下的生与亡（事为步与关系项之对）；不再是为亡，成为为生；有穷世界的生灭之律恰是诸位之可判定。

laws.en: Relative to a continuation of the World model, arising and ceasing are its beginning and ending; a split is fission and a merge the candles' merge; lineages, continuing, links and holding are lines, unchanged by re-identification.
laws.zh: 相对于 World 模型的一个延续，生起与终止是其生与亡；分裂是分叉，合并是蜡烛之合；世系、延续、联系与持有都是线，不因重新认定而变。

laws.en: Passing a pattern on while the carrier ceases is an alteration, ending under the carrier class and continuing under the pattern's (火传); falling dormant is an alteration under holding, and choosing what holds is choosing a class.
laws.zh: 载者终止而传其样式是异：在载者之类下亡，在样式之类下续（火传）；休眠在持有之下是异，择其所持即择一类。

hypotheses.en: None beyond the grammar: every carrier and every relation; where a theorem speaks of a class, the class is an equivalence relation.
hypotheses.zh: 除文法外无前提：每个载体与每个关系；凡定理言类者，类是等价关系。

hypotheses.en: Equality on the carrier is a commitment of the model, used where identity is a class (the positions under identity, the flame, the merge).
hypotheses.zh: 载体之相等是模型的承诺，用于以相等为类之处（相等下的诸位、火、合）。

does_not_show.en: That a class is warranted: constancy says only that a class agrees with 缘; under the full relation every class is constant.
does_not_show.zh: 一个类有根据：有常只说一个类与缘相容；在全关系下每个类都有常。

does_not_show.en: That continuation contained in 缘 tells a fire passed on from one fire ending and another starting: every single 缘 is a continuation under some class, and two conditions each alike to their common outcome make a merge.
does_not_show.zh: 续含于缘，能分开火之传与一火灭、一火生：每一条缘在某个类下都是续，两个各与其共同之果相同的缘成合。

does_not_show.en: That renewal without end tells renewal that sustains life from turnover that destroys it.
does_not_show.zh: 生生分开维持生命之更新与毁灭之更替。

does_not_show.en: That reach orders occurrences where conditions are mutual: it is then a preorder.
does_not_show.zh: 条件互相之处可及给出事之次序：那时它只是预序。

does_not_show.en: That the World model's counting, amounts, recurrence and renaming laws are instances: the grammar states no counting and no map of carriers, so only their premises are connected.
does_not_show.zh: World 模型的计数、量、复现与改名之律是实例：文法不陈述计数，也无载者之映射，故只连其前提。

detail.en: A flame of three moments ending in ash continues under 'flame or not' and has no continuation under that class's core («以核为判据则火无续»).
detail.zh: 三刻之火终于灰，在“火与否”之下相续，在此类之核下无续（«以核为判据则火无续»）。

detail.en: Fission: one occurrence continued by two that go no further makes sameness along lines intransitive («分叉»).
detail.zh: 分叉：一事为二事所续而二事不再续，使沿线之同不传递（«分叉»）。

validation_scope.en: Checked by the core checker with Lean 4.29.1 from the prelude: Becoming.Grammar, 68 theorems in 116 declarations, and the instance sections of Arising, Change, Identity, ContinuedClasses, PatternPassing, Persistence and Space, each declaration with an empty axiom report. The plan it realizes was reviewed in its ninth version by GPT astra and two Opus reviewers; the instance sections were written by three Opus coders and merged with names reconciled. No human review. The OU6 corrections were reviewed against the Lean by GPT astra and Opus reviewers.
validation_scope.zh: 由核心检查器以 Lean 4.29.1 从前奏检查：Becoming.Grammar，116 个声明中 68 条定理，及 Arising、Change、Identity、ContinuedClasses、PatternPassing、Persistence、Space 的实例之节，公理报告皆空。计划第九版经 GPT astra 与两位 Opus 审查者审查；实例之节由三位 Opus 编者写成，合并时统一了名。无人审查。OU6 之更正经 GPT astra 与 Opus 审查者对照 Lean 审查。

next_delta.en: Lift the master laws onto the grammar with their owner, and the theorems that read activity only; state the counting of lines; and give generation and degeneration the content that continuation and renewal alone do not carry.
next_delta.zh: 与其主一同把主律提升到文法上，并提升只读活动之定理；陈述线之计数；给生成与退化以续与复生单独不带之内容。

correspondence.en: For a class, constancy is bisimulation equivalence (Park 1981; Milner 1989) and the core the greatest bisimulation inside the class; reach is the transitive closure of the calculus of relations (Tarski 1941). Continuation relative to a class is close to genidentity (Lewin 1922) and to Whitehead's enduring objects (1929); the closure law is the relational analogue of lumpability (Kemeny and Snell 1960) and of computational closure (Rosas et al. 2024), a correspondence not proved here. The classical readings (四相 in 《大乘起信论》, 六相 in 《金师子章》, 一实 in 《荀子·正名》, the refutation of 相續 in 《中论》) are registered with their losses in the plan.

detail.en: There formation classes are read along a given continuation of the World model, with splits and merges; here continuation itself is 缘 met with a class, for every carrier and relation.
detail.zh: 那里在 World 模型的给定延续上读形成之类，含分与合；这里续本身是缘与类之合，对每个载体与关系。

detail.en: A pattern outlasting its carriers there is a line under a class here; lifting it is the next step.
detail.zh: 那里比其载者更长久的样式，在这里是一个类下的一条线；提升它是下一步。

detail.en: Bisimulation there is between labelled processes; here the core is the greatest symmetric relation constant under one relation inside a class.
detail.zh: 那里的互拟在带标的过程之间；这里核是一个类之内、在一个关系下有常的最大对称关系。

declarations: Becoming.«四相之定当且仅当排中»
Becoming.«类有常当且仅当含于核»

history.en: 23 October 2026, board item OU1 (study section 371): the root of the one-unfolding plan in its tenth version, continuation relative to a class at its centre, after Ren's direction of that day and three reviews of the ninth version; the earlier claim that a line's regularity is its class being constant is corrected by «有常则续不尽».
history.zh: 2026年10月23日，工作板条目 OU1（研究第 371 节）：一元计划第十版之根，以相对于类的续为中心，承 Ren 当日之方向与第九版的三份审查；先前“一条线之理在其类有常”之说由 «有常则续不尽» 更正。

history.en: 23 October 2026, board items OU2 and OU3a (study section 372): the grammar gains holding, mutual need and leaning-on through the core for lines that end, ceasing and 生生不息, and four laws of lines moved down from PatternPassing and Persistence; the old continuation family is stated as its instances. The claim is widened to name the instances; the earlier laws are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日，工作板条目 OU2 与 OU3a（研究第 372 节）：文法增以核定义的自持、相须、因于（适用于终了之线）、息与生生不息，并自 PatternPassing 与 Persistence 移下四条线之律；旧续之族陈述为其实例。论断扩及实例，先前之律不变。

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item OU6 (corrections to the grammar from the review of its sources, study section 400): the theorem on the two-way core renamed «位同则生亡同», since it shows only that beginning and ending carry over; the flame witness restated as mutual need through the core («火薪相须»), with the theorem that it picks no class and a two-flame model in which the fuel left is singled out against sameness of flame; ceasing defined positively, inductively, on renewing into («复生至»): what does not itself renew ceases («自不复生则息»), and the old reading implies the new («不复生则息»); the law on ending under a coarser class narrowed to what its theorem shows (not ending), and the law on the two-way core stated for a class, with abiding carried over too («位同则住同»). The claim is narrowed where a name or a reading said more than the Lean, and the new theorems are added; no other law changes.
history.zh: 2026年10月25日，工作板条目 OU6（据对文法与其来源之审所作之更正，研究第 400 节）：双向之核之定理改名为 «位同则生亡同»，因其只示生与亡相传；火之见证改述为以核相须（«火薪相须»），并证此见证不择类，又立两火之模型，其中余薪同相对于同火而被挑出；息改为正面、以归纳在复生至上定义（«复生至»）：自身不复生者息（«自不复生则息»），旧读蕴含之（«不复生则息»）；粗类下之亡一律收窄为其定理所示（不亡），双向之核一律对一个类而说，住亦相传（«位同则住同»）。凡名或读法说过了 Lean 者，论断收窄；新定理增入；其余之律不变。

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item DF (study section 418): the retired 'old base' named in current vocabulary, the World model, in the statement, two laws, a boundary and a related detail; the merge worded as the Lean states it, each of two conditions alike to the occurrence they condition (not to each other), in the ninth law and a boundary. No law changed in content.
history.zh: 2026年10月25日，工作板条目 DF（研究第 418 节）：退役的“旧基底”按现行词汇称为 World 模型（陈述、两条规律、一条界限与一条相关说明）；合按 Lean 的陈述改写：两个缘各与其所缘之事相同（而非彼此相同），见第九条规律与一条界限。规律内容未变。
